cves.description: Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a PHP code injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject code via the updatedFields parameter into config.inc.php. Attackers can supply a crafted HELPDESK_SUPPORT_EMAIL_ID value that passes email validation but closes the PHP string literal to execute arbitrary operating system commands.

The WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro plugins for WordPress are vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 4.17.0 and 6.17.0, respectively, via deserialization of untrusted input during database restore and staging reset. This is due to the database importer treating attacker-controlled text beginning with {WPSTG_BINARY} as trusted internal binary data and decoding its hexadecimal suffix into serialized bytes. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to plant a malicious serialized object in their own profile. When an Administrator later performs an ordinary database-including restore or staging reset containing that value, and the restored profile metadata is loaded, either during the restore or in a later request, a built-in POP chain can be used to execute arbitrary code on the server. Additional built-in gadget chains allow arbitrary local file read in both WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro and arbitrary file deletion in WP STAGING Pro. The attacker does not require Administrator credentials or a copy of a backup, but exploitation does require the later privileged restore or reset.

The Probono Form Basic WordPress plugin before 1.3.3 does not validate the real type of files uploaded through its public form, trusting the client-declared MIME type instead, which could allow unauthenticated attackers to upload PHP files to a public directory and execute them before they are deleted, on servers that do not honour the Probono Form Basic WordPress plugin before 1.3.3's Apache-only access restriction.

LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in its e-mail-based Helpdesk ticket intake. The mail parser does not reject Apache .htaccess configuration files or PHP-executable files when saving ticket attachments. A remote unauthenticated attacker can e-mail a Helpdesk ticket with such an attachment; in the default configuration, anyone can request the uploaded file's URL which executes attacker-supplied code with the privileges of the web server process. No operator interaction or LMS client session is required.


The issue was fixed in commit d5059b1.

Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI header parameter name verbatim as an array key in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A header parameter name containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including an __construct method that runs when the generated Client is instantiated. Exploitation requires generating a client from an attacker-influenced OpenAPI document and then using the generated SDK, and can execute arbitrary PHP with the consuming application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI query parameter name verbatim as an array key in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A query parameter name containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including an __construct method that runs when the generated Client is instantiated. Exploitation requires generating a client from an attacker-influenced OpenAPI document and then using the generated SDK, and can execute arbitrary PHP with the consuming application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40, main/dropbox/dropbox_functions.inc.php accepts a literal .htaccess filename in the course dropbox and stores it in a directory served by Apache, where the file can alter handler behavior under the required AllowOverride All configuration. Any authenticated course participant can upload .htaccess and then upload a PHP payload disguised as a .gif, resulting in code execution as the web-server user when the dropbox tool is enabled. This can expose or modify the Chamilo installation, course content, and database credentials. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.40.

Grav before 1.7.53.7 and 2.x before 2.2.18 serves page media files, and rendered pages when lazy sessions are enabled, with the visitor's session cookie and a shared-cacheable Cache-Control header. When a shared cache such as Apache mod_cache stores Set-Cookie responses, an attacker can lure a user signed in through the front-end login to open a media URL with a unique query string, then request that URL to receive the cached session cookie and take over the session.

Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, Jane's Reference.php::doResolve passes an attacker-controlled OpenAPI $ref target to file_get_contents without restricting its scheme or resolved local path. When a victim generates code from an attacker-influenced document, an HTTP or HTTPS reference can cause requests to attacker-chosen or internal services, while an absolute or parent-relative path can read local JSON or YAML files and inline the retrieved content into generated output. Exploitation occurs during generation or CI processing and can disclose local files and internal-service responses. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

cves.title: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
cves.description: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

cves.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability

cves.title: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.
cves.product: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap)

cves.title: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
cves.description: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Apache Roller versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The XML-RPC endpoint accepts vendor extension types and deserializes them before authenticating the requester.

This is the same vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384, which listed only Apache Roller 6.1.5 as affected. This issue is being actively exploited.

Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.6 or later, which disables the extension types and rejects XML-RPC requests when the XML-RPC feature is disabled.

Users who cannot upgrade right away should set "enabledForExtensions" to "false" in WEB-INF/web.xml, or remove the "/roller-services/xmlrpc" servlet mapping, and restart Roller. Disabling XML-RPC in the administration UI is not enough, because older versions deserialize the request before checking that setting.

Use after free in GarbageCollection in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)
Use after free in DevTools in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Low)
Use after free in FedCM in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

Confused deputy in TabModel in Google Chrome on on Android prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker leveraging social engineering to bypass web origin policy via UI Interaction. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

Race condition in CredentialProvider in Google Chrome on on Windows prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a local attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a local program. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

cves.title: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
cves.description: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.
Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

Unauthorization vulnerability in the management of workflow definitions in OpenKM Community Edition. The REST endpoints `registerProcessDefinition` and `runProcessDefinition` require authentication but do not verify roles in the WorkflowService or in lower layers. An attacker with the `ROLE_USER` role can register and execute a process definition containing BeanShell scripts, allowing them to execute Java code and operating system commands with the service’s privileges. In the official Docker image, the process runs as root.

MessagePack for Ruby is an implementation of the MessagePack binary serialization format. Prior to 1.8.7, the Java-platform msgpack gem for JRuby allocated arrays and byte buffers directly from attacker-controlled array32, str32, and bin32 declared sizes before confirming that corresponding elements or bytes were available. A short MessagePack header could therefore trigger a very large allocation or sustained heap growth when an application decoded untrusted input through MessagePack.unpack or MessagePack::Unpacker, potentially exhausting the shared JVM heap. map32 and declared counts at or above 2^31 did not use the affected allocation behavior. This issue is fixed in version 1.8.7.

cves.title: UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability
cves.description: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

Algernon is a small self-contained pure-Go web server. Prior to version 1.17.10, Algernon's URL-prefix authorization gate matches its protected prefixes (/admin, /repo, /data) with case-sensitive strings.HasPrefix, while the exact same raw req.URL.Path is later resolved against the filesystem. On case-insensitive filesystems (Windows NTFS — always; macOS APFS/HFS+ — default), a request for /Admin/secret.lua evades every protected-prefix check, falls through to the public-prefix accept branch, and then resolves on disk to admin/secret.lua. The result is an unauthenticated bypass of the /admin, /repo, and /data authorization boundary, enabling read (and, for Lua files, execution) of protected content. The permission system is active in the default configuration. This issue has been patched in version 1.17.10.

The
third-party RMM+ extension for ConnectWise ScreenConnect uses a static API
secret by default. The value can be changed by an administrator; however,
environments retaining the default value may allow unauthorized access to
extension API functionality, including the ability to send commands to managed
agents. This issue is specific to the third-party extension and does not affect
the ScreenConnect server or client.





Scope: This issue affects the third-party RMM+
extension for ConnectWise ScreenConnect. Deployments without the extension are
not affected. ScreenConnect server or client software are not impacted.

Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6301 is affected by an authentication bypass vulnerability in Windows DNS and DHCP agent synchronization APIs, allowing unauthenticated user to impersonate onboarded Windows servers and perform unauthorized DNS and DHCP modifications.

A local user with an ordinary account on the same host can place a file in a shared temporary location that the JDBC driver's native library loading routine will accept and load without verifying its origin. Loading the driver class in a Java application may then run code of that user's choosing inside the application process, which may result in disclosure or alteration of data held by that process or in the process becoming unavailable.

Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Apache Roller. When Roller sends a weblog update ping, its XML-RPC client deserializes Java object data contained in the ping target's response, so a party that controls that response can run code in the Roller server process. This issue affects Apache Roller from 4.0 through 6.1.6. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.1.7, which removes the unsafe deserialization.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows a weblog member with the Limited role to remove or change entries that member may only read, including entries published by other members. The entry editor checked the member's weblog role but not whether that role permits work on the entry.
Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later.

Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) in Apache Roller 5.0.1 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated attacker to create an administrator account if a logged-in Roller administrator opens a link that the attacker controls. The request-token check applied only to POST requests, and administrative actions also accepted GET requests. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which requires POST and a valid token for actions that change data.

Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows an authenticated user with no weblog permissions to read files readable by the Roller process and cause the server to issue outbound HTTP requests to attacker-chosen destinations, by submitting a crafted Atom entry to the AtomPub endpoint. The entry body is parsed with a parser configuration that permits external parameter entities and external DTD subsets, and the parse happens before any per-weblog authorization check and before any check of whether the AtomPub feature is enabled, so the endpoint is reachable by any authenticated account on a default installation. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which parses AtomPub entries with a hardened XML configuration and rejects AtomPub requests while the feature is disabled.
Out-of-bounds write in Microsoft Windows Search Component allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Windows Media Foundation allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

An issue exists in MongoDB's macOS TLS client implementation where certificate chain-of-trust validation is bypassed for outbound connections to IPv6-addressed peers. When a MongoDB process using the Apple SecureTransport TLS backend connects to an IPv6 target, the trust evaluation result from SecTrustEvaluate is silently discarded, regardless of whether the peer's certificate is trusted. An on-path party could exploit this by presenting a self-signed certificate containing the target's IPv6 address in the Subject Alternative Name to intercept and modify encrypted inter-node or external service traffic. This issue only affects MongoDB processes running on macOS with the Apple SecureTransport TLS provider.
Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
Missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

This issue was addressed with improved input validation. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, visionOS 27.2. A remote attacker may be able to break out of the WebContent sandbox.

cves.description: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

cves.title: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
cves.description: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

cves.title: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
cves.description: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

cves.title: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
cves.description: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

cves.title: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
cves.description: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

cves.title: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
cves.description: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

cves.title: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
cves.description: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

cves.title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

cves.title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
cves.description: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

cves.title: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
cves.description: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

cves.title: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
cves.description: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

cves.title: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
cves.description: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.
cves.product: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition

cves.title: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
cves.description: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

cves.title: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
cves.description: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

cves.title: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
cves.description: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

cves.software: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
cves.title: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
cves.description: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.
cves.product: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management

cves.title: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
cves.description: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

cves.title: Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cves.description: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

cves.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
cves.description: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

cves.title: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

cves.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
cves.description: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

cves.title: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
cves.description: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

cves.title: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

cves.title: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
cves.description: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

cves.title: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

cves.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
cves.description: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

cves.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.

cves.title: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
cves.description: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

cves.title: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
cves.description: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

cves.title: Linux Kernel Unspecified Vulnerability
cves.description: Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux.

cves.title: ownCloud Improper Authentication Vulnerability
cves.description: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.

cves.title: JFrog Artifactory Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability
cves.description: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability. This can allow an authenticated user to write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions.

cves.title: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
cves.description: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability which could allow a local user to gain privileged access or cause a denial of service on the system.

cves.title: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
cves.description: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

cves.title: Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
cves.description: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.

cves.title: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cves.description: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool (ABRT) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow local users with certain permissions to gain privileges via a symlink attack on a file with a predictable name. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
cves.product: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool

cves.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
cves.description: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service.
cves.product: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway

cves.title: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cves.description: Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.

cves.title: Gitea Code Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

cves.title: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.
